title: Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor
age_limit: 50 years for Professor, 45 years for Associate Professor (direct recruitment)
summary: Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU) invites online applications for direct recruitment (or deputation) of teaching positions including Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor across various aviation, management, and engineering disciplines.
eligibility_bullets: Possess Master's Degree, Ph.D., or equivalent professional qualifications depending on the specific post.
Fulfill required teaching, research, or industry experience as per UGC guidelines.
National Eligibility Test (NET) or equivalent qualification where applicable.

vacancy_breakdown.category: Associate Professor (Management or Business Administration Courses)
Assistant Professor (Management or Business Administration Courses)

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official recruitment portal at the provided link.
Register and fill out the online application form with required personal and academic details.
Upload necessary documents, certificates, and research publications.
Submit the application before the specified closing date.
